headline_seed: Nepal-China flood survivors reach safe areas as families await news of nearly 3,000 missing - AP News
draft_text:
Flash floods struck the Nepal-China border Aug. 26. Death toll in Nepal: 670+. Roughly 3,000 missing across both countries. AP and CNN report more than 3,700 rescued, including by army helicopter. Rescuers at Gyirong Port found ruins — no survivors.

And that's the mews.
